library_oracles: Outgoing wire messages are byte-semantically identical to all caller messages; no truncation or tool ID changes.
All three distant markers and the two correlated tool calls/results survive template rendering.
Exactly one normalized terminal event, last in stream, with completed reason and observed provider terminal.
Normalized visible content is identical to raw provider SSE content for these plain JSON/integer cases.
Observed prompt usage is within 8 tokens of tokenizer count plus small-template calibration offset; total usage is additive and completion <=128.
Normalized usage agrees with observed raw provider usage.
A real follow-up reuses actual previous assistant output plus complete existing history.

failure_classification.model_behavior_failure: Wire/template/metadata preserved, raw provider output equals normalized output, but exact distant recall or arithmetic is wrong.
failure_classification.library_contract_failure: Messages/tool structures change on wire, provider text or usage is lost/changed, terminal contract invalid.
failure_classification.server_or_transport_failure: Typed HTTP/network/timeout/context failures; preserve diagnostics and stop next size until no task is busy.
failure_classification.harness_failure: Unexpected script/preflight/schema error; preserve and report without counting as product failure.

scope_limits: 24 historical exchanges per case are seeded synthetic fixtures, not 24 independent completed inference calls.
This qualifies complete multi-turn HTTP history plus two actual generated turns at each size.
Not a maximum-context test at 262144 tokens or a quality/performance benchmark.
Tool history is supplied by the test; no MCP executor is invoked.
Each case has an independent history and no implicit cross-case server/session memory is assumed.
